name: net_lod_morale_spawn_probe
description: VUH-2352 guarded development on player defaults: exact MU01_MS102 type2 b_4p978/999 and b_4s1007 generated-wave admission through existing emission arbitration and birth tickets, then matching host/client receipts and final enemy HP parity. Two local instances and a host warp, not D15 native-door acceptance. No new protocol, native-point semantics, mission or save logic.

steps.expr: all((bridge(i).get('puppet0') or {}).get('active') for i in range(2))
log_count('[mission-mirror] client ready',1)==1 and log_count('[mission-mirror] client follow',1)>=1

steps.name: 1 Morale fight MU01_MS102: the friend shows the host's gauge

steps.expr: [[round(p[0]['gauges'][0]['value'],2), round(p[1]['gauges'][0]['value'],2)] for p in [s['value'] for s in saved['fight1_samples'] if 'value' in s and s['value'][0] and s['value'][1] and s['value'][0]['file']==s['value'][1]['file'] and not (s['value'][1]['flags'] & 0x14)]]

steps.message: too few samples with the same mission on both games

steps.expr: sum(1 for h,f in saved['fight1_samples_pairs'] if abs(h-f)<=1.0)>=0.9*len(saved['fight1_samples_pairs'])
steps.message: the friend's gauge did not follow the host's (more than 10% of samples off by over 1.0)

steps.name: 2 The mission ends the same way on both

steps.expr: not (saved['mission_end'][0] and saved['mission_end'][0]['result']==2) and not (saved['mission_end'][1] and saved['mission_end'][1]['result']==2)
steps.message: a mission failed during the success run
the friend's mission did not end with the host's

steps.expr: [log_count('[mission-mirror] host frame',0), log_count('[mission-mirror] client sec following=1',1), log_count('[mission-mirror] client-refused',1), log_count('[mission-mirror] host end trap',0), log_count('[mission-mirror] client end like the host',1)]

steps.message: the mission mirror refused a pin on the friend
the host's end was not replayed on the friend

steps.name: 3 Generated-wave births and host identities match

steps.expr: [log_count('[morale-wave-spawn] observation-only=1 after=1',i) for i in range(2)]

{'host':log_matches(r'\[spawn-emission\] sent epoch=\d+ seq=(?P<seq>\d+) key=(?P<key>1882480482|1932812130) header=(?P<header>978|999|1007) record=(?P<record>\d+) netId=(?P<netId>\d+)',0),'client':log_matches(r'\[spawn-emission\] client emitted epoch=\d+ key=(?P<key>1882480482|1932812130) header=(?P<header>978|999|1007) record=(?P<record>\d+) netId=(?P<netId>\d+) seq=(?P<seq>\d+)',1)}

steps.message: Both roles must return successful observed native generated-wave births; null startup attempts do not qualify
Friend-only or missing later-wave enemies remain; inspect exact native generated-wrapper records and host identities

steps.expr: len(saved['generated_wave_receipts']['host'])>=3 and sorted((b['key'],b['header'],b['record'],b['netId'],b['seq']) for b in saved['generated_wave_receipts']['host'])==sorted((b['key'],b['header'],b['record'],b['netId'],b['seq']) for b in saved['generated_wave_receipts']['client']) and all(int(b['netId'])>0 for b in saved['generated_wave_receipts']['client'])
steps.message: Generated native births must consume every exact host combat occurrence, without friend-only or missing tickets

steps.expr: all(log_count('[spawn-birth] capture-refused',i)==0 and log_count('[privatestatus] stats requested=1 ready=0',i)==0 for i in range(2))
steps.message: Native attachment capture and existing private status must remain qualified
